name: 归档分组
desc: 已归档视图下的子标签「全部归档 / 按日期 / 按周」：默认全部归档且无日期组头；按日期按归档日期分组（同一天一组、最新在前、组头带日期与条数）；按周按 ISO 周分组（组头含年/周与起止日期）；查看方式写入 sessionStorage、刷新后保持。归档数据用 crafted archivedAt（今天两条 / 昨天一条 / 9 天前一条）直接写存储来构造多天场景

steps.eval: if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.wipe = async () => { const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app'); const K = '__todo_test_backup_v1'; if (localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_dirty') === '1') { const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K) || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } } const snap = { todos: await s.getItem('todos'), groups: await s.getItem('groups'), ui: await s.getItem('ui') }; localStorage.setItem(K, JSON.stringify(snap)); localStorage.setItem('__todo_test_dirty', '1'); await s.removeItem('todos'); await s.removeItem('groups'); await s.removeItem('ui'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'wiped, backup todos=' + (snap.todos ? snap.todos.length : 0); }; return await T.wipe();

if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.q = (s) => { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); const r = p && p.shadowRoot; return r ? Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s)) : []; }; T.ready = async (sel, ms) => { const n = Math.ceil((ms || 3000) / 100); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (T.q(sel).length) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error('页面就绪超时，找不到 ' + sel); }; T.tx = (el) => el.textContent.trim(); T.click = (el) => { if (!el) throw new Error('元素不存在'); const b = el.shadowRoot && el.shadowRoot.querySelector('button'); (b || el).click(); return true; }; T.wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms || 300)); T.tab = (t, i) => { const groups = T.q('st-button-group'); const g = groups[i || 0]; if (!g) throw new Error('找不到第 ' + (i || 0) + ' 个按钮组'); const b = Array.from(g.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((x) => T.tx(x) === t); if (!b) throw new Error('找不到标签：' + t); return T.click(b); }; T.day = (off) => { const d = new Date(); d.setHours(10, 0, 0, 0); d.setDate(d.getDate() - (off || 0)); return d.getTime(); }; T.mmdd = (off) => { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() - (off || 0)); const p = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0'); return p(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p(d.getDate()); }; await T.ready('.shell'); const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app'); const mk = (id, text, archivedAt) => ({ id: id, text: text, desc: '', groupId: 'default', done: true, createdAt: archivedAt - 1000, statusChangedAt: archivedAt - 500, archivedAt: archivedAt, deletedAt: null, pendingDeleteAt: null }); await s.setItem('todos', [ mk('t1', '今天甲', T.day(0)), mk('t2', '今天乙', T.day(0) - 7200000), mk('t3', '昨天', T.day(1)), mk('t4', '九天前', T.day(9)) ]); sessionStorage.setItem('todo-ui-state', JSON.stringify({ view: 'archived', groupFilter: 'all', archiveGroup: 'all' })); return 'crafted 4 archived todos';

let root = null; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); root = p && p.shadowRoot; if (root && root.querySelector('.shell')) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (!root || !root.querySelector('.shell')) throw new Error('刷新后页面未就绪'); const all = (s) => Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(s)); const tabs = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('st-button-group'))[1]; if (!tabs) throw new Error('已归档视图缺少子标签组'); const labels = Array.from(tabs.querySelectorAll('st-button')).map((b) => b.textContent.trim()); if (labels.join(',') !== '全部归档,按日期,按周') throw new Error('子标签文案不正确：' + labels); const cur = Array.from(tabs.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((b) => b.getAttribute('variant') === 'filled'); if (cur.textContent.trim() !== '全部归档') throw new Error('默认应选中「全部归档」：' + cur.textContent.trim()); const items = all('.item'); if (items.length !== 4) throw new Error('全部归档应平铺 4 条，实际 ' + items.length); const heads = all('.agroup-head').filter((h) => getComputedStyle(h).display !== 'none'); if (heads.length !== 0) throw new Error('「全部归档」不应有日期组头，实际 ' + heads.length); return 'ok';

const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); const root = p.shadowRoot; const q = (s) => Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(s)); const tx = (el) => el.textContent.trim(); const click = (el) => { const b = el.shadowRoot && el.shadowRoot.querySelector('button'); (b || el).click(); }; const tabs = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('st-button-group'))[1]; click(Array.from(tabs.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((x) => tx(x) === '按日期')); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const heads = q('.agroup-head').filter((h) => getComputedStyle(h).display !== 'none'); if (heads.length !== 3) throw new Error('按日期应有 3 个日期组，实际 ' + heads.length + '（' + heads.map(tx).join(' | ') + '）'); const texts = heads.map((h) => tx(h)); const p2 = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0'); const d = new Date(); const today = p2(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p2(d.getDate()); const d9 = new Date(); d9.setDate(d9.getDate() - 9); const day9 = p2(d9.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p2(d9.getDate()); const d1 = new Date(); d1.setDate(d1.getDate() - 1); const day1 = p2(d1.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + p2(d1.getDate()); if (texts[0].indexOf(today) !== 0) throw new Error('最新一组应是今天（' + today + '），实际 ' + texts[0]); if (texts[1].indexOf(day1) !== 0) throw new Error('第二组应是昨天（' + day1 + '），实际 ' + texts[1]); if (texts[2].indexOf(day9) !== 0) throw new Error('第三组应是 9 天前（' + day9 + '），实际 ' + texts[2]); if (texts[1].indexOf('周') === -1) throw new Error('组头应带星期：' + texts[1]); if (q('.agroup-head').find((h) => tx(h) === texts[0]).textContent.indexOf('2 项') === -1) throw new Error('今天那组应显示「2 项」：' + texts[0]); const groups = q('.agroup'); if (groups.length !== 3) throw new Error('应有 3 个分组容器，实际 ' + groups.length); const counts = groups.map((g) => Array.from(g.querySelectorAll('.item')).length); if (counts.join(',') !== '2,1,1') throw new Error('各组条数应为 2,1,1，实际 ' + counts); const items = q('.item'); if (items.length !== 4) throw new Error('按日期下总条数应仍为 4，实际 ' + items.length); if (tx(items[0].querySelector('.text')) !== '今天甲') throw new Error('组内应保持原有顺序：' + tx(items[0].querySelector('.text'))); return 'ok: ' + texts.join(' | ');

const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); const root = p.shadowRoot; const q = (s) => Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(s)); const tx = (el) => el.textContent.trim(); const click = (el) => { const b = el.shadowRoot && el.shadowRoot.querySelector('button'); (b || el).click(); }; const tabs = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('st-button-group'))[1]; click(Array.from(tabs.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((x) => tx(x) === '按周')); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); const heads = q('.agroup-head').filter((h) => getComputedStyle(h).display !== 'none'); if (heads.length < 2) throw new Error('按周至少应有 2 组（今天+昨天 与 9 天前 不在同一周），实际 ' + heads.length); const texts = heads.map((h) => tx(h)); for (const t of texts) { if (t.indexOf('年第') === -1 || t.indexOf('周') === -1 || t.indexOf(' ~ ') === -1) throw new Error('周组头文案应含「年第 N 周 · 起止」：' + t); } const groups = q('.agroup'); const counts = groups.map((g) => Array.from(g.querySelectorAll('.item')).length); const total = counts.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0); if (total !== 4) throw new Error('按周下总条数应仍为 4，实际 ' + total); const lastGroup = groups[groups.length - 1]; const lastTitles = Array.from(lastGroup.querySelectorAll('.text')).map(tx); if (lastTitles.join(',') !== '九天前') throw new Error('最早的一组应是「九天前」，实际 ' + lastTitles); const sess = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('todo-ui-state') || 'null'); if (!sess || sess.archiveGroup !== 'week') throw new Error('查看方式应写入会话状态：' + JSON.stringify(sess)); return 'ok: ' + texts.join(' | ');

let root = null; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); root = p && p.shadowRoot; if (root && root.querySelector('.shell')) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (!root || !root.querySelector('.shell')) throw new Error('刷新后页面未就绪'); const all = (s) => Array.from(root.querySelectorAll(s)); const tabs = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('st-button-group'))[1]; const cur = Array.from(tabs.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((b) => b.getAttribute('variant') === 'filled'); if (cur.textContent.trim() !== '按周') throw new Error('刷新后应仍停在「按周」：' + cur.textContent.trim()); const heads = all('.agroup-head').filter((h) => getComputedStyle(h).display !== 'none'); if (heads.length < 2) throw new Error('刷新后应仍显示周分组，实际 ' + heads.length); const items = all('.item'); if (items.length !== 4) throw new Error('刷新后归档条目应仍为 4，实际 ' + items.length); const t3 = items.find((i) => i.querySelector('.text').textContent.trim() === '昨天'); if (!t3 || !t3.className.includes('archived')) throw new Error('归档条目样式丢失'); return 'ok';

const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app'); const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_backup_v1') || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } localStorage.removeItem('__todo_test_dirty'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'restored';
